More Details

This dataset contains the wastewater interceptors within the MCES regional wastewater system and provides a spatial data inventory to aid maintenance, planning, and analysis efforts. The interceptor system connects the local community sewer systems to the wastewater treatment plants (WWTP).
snippet: This Metropolitan Council dataset contains the wastewater interceptors within the Metropolitan Council Environmental Services (MCES) regional wastewater system.
